text.tspan: Share of people enrolled in tertiary education
Shown as the gross enrollment ratio — the number of people, regardless of their age, who are enrolled in tertiary
education, expressed as a percentage of the population of tertiary education age (typically 18–22 years).
Data source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2026)
Note: Values may exceed 100% when children who are older or younger than the official age group also enroll.
